# Version 4.156.2 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering correctness fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.2 improves filtered-image and glyph rendering with native fixes on the existing Skia m156 engine.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Keep antialiased image sampling in bounds** — Filtered images and Ganesh draws keep sampling within their intended image subsets and logical texture bounds under minification, strong skew, AA clipping, and MSAA. This prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from contaminating the output when filter padding is insufficient. ([#5773](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5773))
- **Consistent image-filter cache keys** — Image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash, distinguishing signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata consistently and avoiding floating-point-mode-dependent subnormal comparisons. ([#5773](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5773))
- **Handle changing mask-filtered glyphs safely** — Glyph rendering uses the reloaded glyph's path when consecutive font-scaler loads disagree. Matching mask formats are required before copying, and clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides, avoiding stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted or uncleared mask planes. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))
